name: Volumetric Primitive PRB Integrator
definition: A path tracer for volumetric primitives using multiple importance sampling with PDF balancing, supporting derivatives via Dr.Jit.
summary: The Volumetric Primitive PRB Integrator renders scattering and emissive media using kernel-based primitives instead of voxel grids, distinguishing itself from the tomography integrator by supporting scattering via multiple importance sampling.
